description: Header file defining the Blit11 class for texture copy and blitting operations in Direct3D 11 within the ANGLE project. It includes method declarations for texture swizzling, copying textures, depth/stencil operations, shader management, and resource initialization.

classes.name: rx::Blit11
classes.description: A utility class for performing texture blitting, copying, and related operations in Direct3D 11 within ANGLE.

classes.name: rx::Shader
classes.description: Represents a shader with associated resources and state.

classes.name: rx::ShaderSupport
classes.description: Holds support resources for shaders, including input layout and shader stages.

methods.name: swizzleTexture
methods.description: Performs texture swizzling based on the provided swizzle state.

methods.name: copyTexture
methods.description: Copies a texture from source to destination, with optional downsampling.

methods.name: copyStencil
methods.description: Copies stencil buffer data from source to destination.

methods.name: copyDepth
methods.description: Copies depth buffer data from source to destination.

methods.name: copyDepthStencil
methods.description: Copies combined depth and stencil buffer data.

methods.name: resolveDepth
methods.description: Resolves depth data from a render target.

methods.name: resolveStencil
methods.description: Resolves stencil data from a render target.

methods.name: initResources
methods.description: Initializes GPU resources needed for blitting operations.

methods.name: getShaderSupport
methods.description: Retrieves shader support resources for a given shader.

methods.name: getBlitShader
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a shader for blitting between formats.

methods.name: getSwizzleShader
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a shader for texture swizzling.

methods.name: addBlitShaderToMap
methods.description: Adds a blit shader to the internal shader map.

methods.name: addSwizzleShaderToMap
methods.description: Adds a swizzle shader to the internal shader map.

methods.name: releaseResolveDepthStencilResources
methods.description: Releases resources used for depth/stencil resolve operations.
